hits.text: OWC QUIC stage 2 (2026-10-14, delivered /tmp/owc-r4/deliver/quic-stage2): guest QUIC runs as an esbuild bundle of src/network/quic (guest-entry.ts) generated into guest/modules/quic.ts by scripts/build-quic-guest.mjs; './crypto' resolves to guest-crypto.ts (callCap: crypto.hmac, tls.aead.*, new quic.hp.mask). QUIC_SRC is lazy: OWC_QUIC() compiles on first use (eager compile cost ~18 ms per guest process; lazy lexing ~5-7 ms). Internal builtin require('owc:internal/quic'). Gotchas: (1) Buffer.prototype.slice is a VIEW in Node and in the OWC guest; stage 1 removeHeaderProtection writes the unmasked header into packet.slice(), so opening a Buffer datagram twice fails authentication -- copy datagrams to plain Uint8Array at the socket boundary. (2) aioquic asyncio connect(wait_connected=False) transmits nothing until proto.transmit(). (3) aioquic request_key_update() ignores the RFC 9001 6.1 ACK precondition; space updates one round apart or tolerate consecutive updates. (4) aioquic emits ConnectionTerminated only after its draining period (~3 PTO); wait before killing it. (5) the OWC bridge (all copies) has no UDP loss hook. Witness driver: /tmp/owc-r4/impl-quic2/probe/container-witness.mts (OWC_CORE env selects the core copy).

NEVER use quickjs-emscripten 0.32 evalCode {type:'module', compileOnly:true}. QTS_Eval (c/interface.c) then calls JS_GetModuleNamespace on an uninitialized `module` pointer: bogus failures, leaked objects, and a JS_FreeRuntime list_empty abort that kills the shared WASM instance ('RuntimeError: unreachable' in the guest). Safe native module parse check (process.ts parsesAsModule): in a throwaway runtime evaluate `import "<file>"; import "owc:parse-check-stop";` with type module (not compileOnly). The loader returns the source for <file>, '' for other imports, and {error} for the stop module, so nothing links or runs. Only SyntaxError = parse failure. Module names must not contain NUL (truncated as a C string). esmSource order: regex gate, guest rxRewrite, parse check only if the rewrite changed something; keeps the 1.6 MB case within 5% of round 1. Hub: a host-owned unattached server side stays 'claimable' while the host holds the 'connection' payload (FinalizationRegistry, /// reference lib es2021.weakref), so late attach gets data>end>close like Node pauseOnConnect; heap flat at 100k.

scan_deps {root:<abs dir>} refuses a directory without package.json ('is not a real, existing project directory the host will grant access to'), e.g. /tmp/owc-r4/esmfix; pass the package directory itself (/tmp/owc-r4/esmfix/mm accepted: failCount 0, blockedCount 0, warnCount 0). Witnessed 2026-10-14.
